[Intro]
[Cm]

[Verse 1]
[Cm]There is a roadway,
muddy and foxgloved
Whenever I'd have
life enough, my heart is
scream in' of
And in a few days
I would be there, love
Whatever here that's
left of me is yours just
as it was

[Chorus]
[Ab]
Just as it [Bb]was, baby
[Gm]Be-
fore the [Cm]otherness
[Eb]came [Fm]
[Ab]And I
knew its name [Bb]
[Gm]The drug, the
dark, the [Eb]light, the [Fm]flame The

[Bridge]
[Cm]highs hit the heights of my
[Csus4/D]baby And its hold
[Eb]had the fight of my
[Fm]baby And the lights
[Ab]were as bright as my ba-
[Cm]by
[Fm]But your love was unmoved

[Interlude]
[Cm]

[Verse 2]
[Cm]Tell me if somehow,
some of it remains
How long you would
wait for me? And how long I've
been away
The
shape that I'm in now, your
shape in the doorway
Make your good love
known to me Or just tell me
'bout your day

[Chorus]
[Ab]
Just as it [Bb]was, baby
[Gm]Be-
fore the [Cm]otherness
[Eb]came [Fm]
[Ab]And I
knew its name [Bb]
[Gm]The drug, the
dark, the [Eb]light, the [Fm]shame The

[Bridge]
[Cm]highs hit the heights of my
[Csus4/D]baby And its hold
[Eb]had the fight of my
[Fm]baby And the lights
[Ab]were as bright as my ba-
[Cm]by
[Fm]But your love was unmoved
[Cm]And the sights
were as stark as my ba-
[Csus4/D]by And the cold
[Eb]cut as sharp as my
[Fm]baby And the nights
[Ab]were as dark as my ba-
[Cm]by
[Fm]And half as beautiful too

[Outro]
[Cm]

[Outro 2]
title: As It Was
tuning: C F A# D# G C
